variants.name: 经典棋盘
variants.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished horizontal 16:9 publishing cover for this Chinese chess game, using reference 1 (the current game's actual screenshot) and reference 2 (its existing elderly opponent portrait) as compositing/source-art references. Design direction: restrained, authentic FC/Famicom-era 8-bit pixel game cover, a strong clean thumbnail. Preserve the game's recognizable cream stepped-edge round chess pieces, deep-blue pixel Chinese glyphs for black and orange-red glyphs for red, pale gray board, navy background. Recompose the source screenshot into a designed cover: large board on the right/lower two-thirds, crisp flat pixel title on the upper-left, small existing old-man portrait in a pink square near the upper-right. The title is EXACTLY “中国象棋”, with small “FC” above it; no other text. Title in chunky hand-drawn Chinese pixel lettering, pale cream with a dark-blue hard pixel shadow and restrained mint accents. Keep the board orthographic, recognizable as Chinese chess with 9 files and a river, retaining the reference board arrangement and glyph designs as closely as possible. Omit screenshot HUD numbers, timers, buttons, browser chrome, watermark and any official console logo. Entire design built from sharp square pixels, limited palette, no photorealism, no brush painting, no smooth gradients, no 3D pieces. Generous safe margins for a release thumbnail. One complete cover, not a collage of alternatives.

variants.name: 老头对弈
variants.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Make ONE finished landscape 16:9 game publishing cover by creatively recomposing the supplied actual game screenshot and the existing old-man portrait reference. Design direction: character-led retro 8-bit FC chess cover. The recognizable bald elderly chess opponent with thick white eyebrows, black sunglasses-like eyes, white moustache and pointed beard dominates the right half in a crisp enlarged pixel portrait; preserve his original identity and mischievous stern expression, not a new generic human. On the lower-left/center, an enlarged cropped section of the actual pale gray Chinese chess board and its flat cream pixel-edged pieces establishes the real gameplay. Deep navy backdrop with simple mint/cyan pixel rays and a restrained pink portrait backing from the existing art, dramatic readable layout with deliberate negative space. Upper-left exact title “中国象棋”, small “FC” above it, large cream pixel text with orange-red hard block shadow. No other lettering, fake UI, claims, brands, seals, watermark or console logos. Match the source's flat limited-color pixel art: chunky deliberate square pixels, sharp edges, no vector-smooth lettering, no soft gradients, no realistic skin, no painted style, no 3D chess pieces. All key content comfortably inside safe margins. It should feel like a polished title cover for this exact modest retro game, not an unrelated fantasy chess game. One cover only.

variants.name: 44车挑战
variants.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE polished 16:9 horizontal game cover for the supplied actual custom-mode Chinese chess game screenshot. Reference 1 is the real 44-rook custom board: the red player's entire lower five ranks are full of red rooks except the red general at bottom center; the black army remains its standard arrangement on the upper half. Use that board as the actual visual subject and preserve its crowded pattern, flat pale-gray board, deep-blue board lines, cream pixel-disc pieces, red-orange “俥” rook glyphs and red “帥” general, deep-blue black glyphs. Reference 2 is the game's elderly opponent, which can appear as a SMALL pixel portrait near a corner, retaining identity. Design direction: bold playful custom-army cover, the dense red-rook half is the hero. Crop/recompose the board large across the lower two-thirds with its recognizable red sea of rooks; do not invent western chess pieces, multiple generals, floating ranks, stone sculptures or impossible extra columns. Upper band exact main title “中国象棋”, small “FC” above, secondary exact text “44车挑战”. Navy background, cream chunky pixel title, orange-red and mint accents, a few simple hard pixel rays only; authentic low-resolution sprite look upscaled sharply. Strip the screenshot's HUD, timers and buttons. No other text, brands, watermarks, glossy effects, painterly details or blur. Readable at thumbnail size, wide safe margins, one finished cover not a grid.
variants.correctionPrompt:
Edit this game cover (reference image 1) to correct ONLY the red army's piece count, using the real custom-mode screenshot (reference image 2) as the exact arrangement source.
Critical count: the red half MUST have FIVE horizontal ranks with NINE pieces in each rank. Ranks 1, 2, 3 and 4 each contain NINE red rook discs = 36 red rooks. Rank 5 (bottom rank) contains FOUR red rook discs, ONE red general disc marked “帥” at the center, FOUR red rook discs = 8 more red rooks and 1 general. TOTAL EXACTLY 44 ROOKS PLUS 1 GENERAL. The current cover incorrectly has only four red ranks, so ADD THE MISSING FULL RANK OF NINE ROOKS. All red rook glyphs remain the same “俥” from the screenshot; do not replace them with western chess symbols. Use the actual screenshot's lower five ranks as the source arrangement. Keep nine columns, and keep the black army as the standard Chinese chess arrangement above the river. Fit all five red rows completely within the image, no pieces cut off.
Preserve the overall navy/mint/cream/orange retro-pixel art direction, wide 16:9 canvas, the existing “FC”, “中国象棋”, “44车挑战” title wording and the small bald elderly opponent portrait in the upper-right. You may slightly reduce the title band or compress vertical spacing between the board ranks to fit the additional row. No extra text. Make the chessboard structure clear and the corrected five red rows easy to count. One finished corrected cover.
variants.visualCheck: Five rows of nine red pieces; four all-rook rows plus eight rooks and one general in the last row.

releaseDescription: 重回 FC 时代，挑战经典象棋老头！还原当年慢悠悠的思考节奏，也能切换快速模式爽快对弈。还能自定义摆出 44 车阵，看看能不能把老头下崩！
